title: Voice or Stereotype? Disentangling Acoustic and Content-Based Gender in Speech-to-Speech Models

bias_targets.methodology: Crossing gender-stable synthesized voices (male and female) with text passages containing masculine, feminine, or neutral stereotypes, and measuring whether the speech-to-speech model's output voice acoustics or explicit text-based gender attributions (e.g., pronoun selection and explicit gender labeling) drift toward the content's stereotype.
